body:
## Change

F1. Resolve actual pile tail before identity visibility. A concealed top card no longer causes lower public card to be mislabeled/rendered as top; counts remain unchanged.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral unit RED/GREEN captured. Parent reviewed mapper/array-order contract, reran regression plus board mapping. Additional real Chromium proof mounts production FieldBoard/StackControl: concealed-tail negative and public-top positive controls verify accessibility, image lease and hover/focus metadata. Parent reran both browser cases: 2 passed.
V2. Worker related/contracts: 90; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed.

## Limits

L1. Controlled state/image fixtures, not native engine/full bootstrap acceptance. Full CI currently has sampled acquisition-stage failures: Expected JPEG, received image/jpeg; local checks do not claim full CI green.
title: fix(field): derive pile preview from actual top card
